title: tanacetum integrifolium
intro: Tanacetum integrifolium, commonly known as Mountain Tansy, is a perennial plant species belonging to the daisy family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its multiple health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Tansy are attributed to its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, and to its spasmolytic effects, which help to relax muscles. The bioactive constituents of Tanacetum integrifolium include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
